spec2def(odbc32.dll odbc32.spec)

 # CORE-5743: No ARRAY_SIZE macro

# odbc32.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/odbc32-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(odbc32_shims OBJECT proxyodbc.c)
target_link_libraries(odbc32_shims PRIVATE wine libadvapi32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module_fixme(odbc32_shims)
add_cargo_module(odbc32 odbc32-cargo odbc32.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS odbc32_shims psdk)
